prefill_mechanism.attribution: at least 99 percent of 11,545 fills are prefill, derived from the proven mechanism and the explicit-zero count
prefill_mechanism.cause: torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True) enables fill_uninitialized_memory; every empty/empty_like becomes allocation plus NaN fill
prefill_mechanism.explicit_zeros_in_model: about 64 per update (model.py:143 per MoE layer, model.py:214 per forward)
prefill_mechanism.proven_on_device: PERF-3D diag: deterministic off 0 fills, on 2 per call, fill flag off 0 fills

launch_families.source: PERF-3D trace a0/b0, 8 profiled updates each, kernel events only

meta.correction: PERF-3D reported fill 17.8 ms/update, counting only FillFunctor<c10::BFloat16>; all fill types total 11,545 kernels and 43.8 ms/update. PERF-3D decision unchanged.
meta.experiment: v3.1-PERF-4A host overhead and launch amortization audit
meta.mode: read-only audit: no GPU execution, no training, no benchmark, no code change

abort: any field mismatch or non-deterministic baseline
fills not reduced to the explicit-zero baseline
wall improvement below 10 ms (falsifies the host-bound model)
GPU fault, drift, or VRAM above guard
perf4b_design.gate: two-update deterministic run: baseline twice plus variant once from the verified step-0 state; logits, CE, aux, router, gradient, weight, optimizer-state digests and lr; zero mismatches and a deterministic baseline
perf4b_design.memory_power: peak allocated and reserved must not exceed 5.568/6.107 GiB and must stay under the guard; power reported, not decisive
perf4b_design.rollback: delete the two experimental files; production path untouched
perf4b_design.shim: wrap torch.use_deterministic_algorithms so the prefill flag is cleared immediately after the loop enables deterministic mode; kernel determinism stays on
perf4b_design.single_variable: deterministic NaN prefill off, everything else identical
tests: flag state: determinism on, prefill off via shim; both restored without shim
prefill count: fills drop from about 11545 to the explicit-zero baseline of about 64 per update, measured by kernel name
uninitialized-content invariance: two gate runs with the flag off, allocator primed with 0xAA then 0x55, bitwise identical results
perf4b_design.timing: production train() with stop_after=60, log_every=1, eval_interval=1000; four interleaved arms baseline/no-prefill/no-prefill/baseline; medians and trimmed means; one profiled arm per condition for kernel counts
